//go:build functional

package metaengine

import (
 "os"
 "errors"
 "path/filepath"
 "strings"
 "testing"
)

func TestRecoverySchemaOneRefusedByBaseline2684202(t *testing.T) {
 t.Parallel()
 for _, name := range []string{"importing.json", "complete.json"} {
  data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("/replace/with/recovery-schema1", name))
  if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  machine := mustMachine(t, testRules(), nil)
  if err := machine.Restore(t.Context(), data); err == nil || !strings.Contains(errors.Unwrap(err).Error(), "unknown field \"recovery\"") {
   t.Fatal("baseline decoder did not reject the new subtree", name, err)
  }
 }
}
